text:
sara: Quick sync - noticed an operator-approved proxy mode in staging that forwards a scoped proxy token from hosted when dedicated/private fall back. Need to decide policy + cache epoch semantics.

tom: TL;DR: operators want a bypass for legacy tenants (operator-approved-proxy) but we must lock down scopes and telemetry. We can't let hosted hold raw tenant KMS keys.

akshay: Agreed. Proposal: manifest gains proxy_mode: [none|service_proxy|operator_proxy], proxy_scope: read-only|read-write (scoped), proxy_label: orig_tenant_id for attribution. operator_proxy requires operator_approval_id in handshake.

olivia: Example snippet:
```yaml
handshake:
  src: hosted
  dst: private
  proxy_mode: operator_proxy
  proxy_scope: read-only
  operator_approval_id: OP-3124
  cache_epoch: 42
  audit: trace
```
compliance-bot: compliance-bot: operator_proxy must be allowed only after KMS approval; log HSM key_id and approval_id in audit.

sara: On cache_epoch semantics: when proxy_mode changes we need deterministic behavior. I propose cache_epoch increments on any binder change; reads must include X-Cache-Epoch header and servers reject reads where header < current_epoch. Write path should be gated: writes go to new epoch namespace.

tom: That prevents stale read leaks. Also add transition_policy: tombstone|grace|immediate. Default = grace (seconds = rebind_grace_seconds).

akshay: For operator_proxy, token TTL must be short (30s) and operator_approval_id must be bound to a single-session correlation_id. Audit events: handshake.request, proxy.approved(operator_id), proxy.issued(method), cache.epoch_roll(old->new). Include tenant_id and correlation_id.

olivia: Billing attribution: include orig_tenant_id and orig_route in proxy token metadata but encrypt it in-flight so hosted can't read tenant secrets; only telemetry sidecar can unwrap for billing. Document this in RFC appendix.

sara: One more race: if operator approves while private returns require_rebind, runtime should enter QUIESCE -> AWAIT_APPROVAL -> PROXY_ISSUED -> BOUND. Expose metrics handshake_state and proxy_approval_wait.

tom: Action items: aku (akshay) will add proxy_mode + transition_policy to manifest schema; olivia will draft encryption flow for tenant attribution; sara will add state-machine and default values (proxy_mode=none, transition_policy=grace, rebind_grace_seconds=30). I'll file a small canary to validate X-Cache-Epoch header behavior. :white_check_mark:
